then.text: {greeting} Back again? The caves never look the same twice. Well, they do. But the light's different.
You stopped him? Thank goodness. A stalactite that size took thousands of years to grow. Snap it and that's it, gone, forever, for a selfie.
Here, this is for you. The Geopark Pin: we give them to our friends of the caves. And a bit of boxty from my lunchbox, because you've earned it.
The boatman's down by the water. Over the river, and through to the Grand Gallery. Shout if you see anything you shouldn't. Like a caver with a hammer.

else.text: {greeting} I'm Niamh, I'll be your guide. Welcome to the Marble Arch Caves, under Cuilcagh mountain. Three rivers sink into the hill up there and meet down here, in the dark.

We start with a boat ride on the underground river, then walk through to the Grand Gallery. Only, there's a problem. Somebody saw a caver go through with a hammer, and I've a horrible feeling about our stalactites.
Will you take the boat and have a look?

then.text: Brilliant. The boatman's just through there. Keep your hands in the boat. The cave doesn't bite, but the roof is low.

else.text: No bother. The cave's been here three hundred million years. It can wait.

en_boatman.text: {greeting} All aboard. Heads down for the low bit. And keep your voice down: the echo carries, and the bats are trying to sleep.
The boat glides along black water under a ceiling of hanging stone. Somewhere, water drips. Then drips again. Then, rudely, on your head.

then.text: I'm leaving, I'm leaving. I've put the hammer away. I'm going to take up something safer. Like eels.
